get_me.title: Get My Profile
get_me.description: Get the profile of the user who owns the API token: id, first name, last name and email. Use it to confirm which Youform account the connection is acting as.

list_forms.title: List Forms
list_forms.description: List all forms owned by the authenticated user, paginated. Each form carries its numeric id, slug (needed by get_form, list_form_submissions and create_webhook), name, field blocks, design, settings and submissions_count. Use get_form for one form by slug.

page.description: Page number of the paginated result (Laravel-style pagination; see last_page / next_page_url in the response).

output.description: A Laravel paginator: data (array of forms), current_page, last_page, per_page, total, next_page_url.

get_form.title: Get Form
get_form.description: Get one form by its slug: name, description, published field blocks (fields) and unpublished draft_fields, design, settings, webhook_url, hidden fields and messages. Use it to map the field UUID keys in submission data back to question titles.

form_slug.description: The form's slug (the short id in its share URL, e.g. kyir3qrg), as returned in the slug field of list_forms.

list_form_submissions.title: List Form Submissions
list_form_submissions.description: List submissions of a form, paginated (20 per page by default, up to 100 with per_page), oldest first unless sort_by=created_at and sort_by_order=desc. Each submission has id, uid, data (answers keyed by field block UUID), is_complete, completed_at, created_at and refill_link_enabled. Partial-submission filtering (is_complete) requires a Pro plan; on free plans leave it out or the API returns 400.

form_slug.description: The form's slug (the short id in its share URL, e.g. kyir3qrg), as returned in the slug field of list_forms.

is_complete.description: true returns only completed submissions, false only partial ones; omit for all. Pro plan only - do not send on free plans.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, e.g. created_at.

page.description: Page number of the paginated result (Laravel-style pagination; see last_page / next_page_url in the response).

output.description: A Laravel paginator: data (array of submissions), current_page, last_page, per_page, total, next_page_url.

create_webhook.title: Create Webhook
create_webhook.description: Register a webhook URL on a form so Youform POSTs each new submission to it. Returns the new webhook's id, which delete_webhook needs.

form_slug.description: The form's slug (the short id in its share URL, e.g. kyir3qrg), as returned in the slug field of list_forms.

webhook_url.description: The URL that should receive submission payloads.

output.description: success flag and data.id of the created webhook.

delete_webhook.title: Delete Webhook
delete_webhook.description: Delete a webhook by its id (from create_webhook) so the form stops sending submissions to that URL. Cannot be undone; recreate it with create_webhook if needed.

webhook_id.description: The webhook id returned by create_webhook.

set_submission_refill_link.title: Set Submission Refill Link
set_submission_refill_link.description: Enable or disable the refill link of a submission, which lets the respondent reopen and edit their answers. Pass the numeric submission id (from list_form_submissions) and enable true/false.

submission_id.description: Numeric submission id (the id field, not uid).

enable.description: true to enable the refill link, false to disable it.
